nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Super Fluid Daily UV Defense SPF 50+

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination skin, including one with an oily T-zone, describe the formula as non-greasy and pore-friendly, though a couple report it sits heavy and greasy on oily areas.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with severe dryness and sensitivity, report it hydrates and applies without stinging, though one found it insufficient for winter dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (oily T-zone, normal to dry elsewhere) report it blends in seamlessly and does not cause breakouts, though one with combination skin found it greasy and pore-clogging.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea or a history of skin reactions, consistently report no stinging, irritation, or breakouts.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with oily or acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts or clogged pores after regular use; one reviewer says pimples appeared for the first time in her life and persisted for months after use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea report the sunscreen does not aggravate flare-ups and is gentle enough for reactive skin.
concerns.spots: A small number of reviewers report the sunscreen protected against new sunspots or, in one case, helped hyperpigmentation fade over a summer of use.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers mention the formula fills in fine lines or offers anti-aging benefits, though this is a minor theme in the reviews supplied.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns near the eyes
Layers well as a makeup base

extraits.texte: Like other people said, it is SLIDING on my face, leave marks on where the sunglasses were. My face got pimples (yes, which I never had had in my life) really really bad. These are still here after months now. I decided to use it on my body, guess what? The seat, the door, the wheel, even the outside of my car had white cast. 😑 I don't get the hype of this product tbh.

I love this sunscreen. I have sensitive skin and rosacea so it's hard finding a facial sunscreen that doesn't break me out. This keeps my face moisturized while being protected, and without causing breakouts.

extraits.titre: No White Cast And Easily Blends And Absorbs
extraits.texte: I have been using this sunscreen for the past few weeks and have found that it works great with my skin. I have combination skin that is slightly oily at the t-zone and normal to dry everywhere else. This blends in seamlessly and absorbs quickly without leaving a white cast and leaving my skin feeling greasy. I also appreciate that it doesn't make me break out like previous sunscreens have in the past. I will continue to purchase this in the future and have already recommended it to family and friends.

I have super dry and flaky skin on top of it being super sensitive. I was nervous about trying this product because a lot of sunscreens I've used in the past have caused irritation and redness. This sunscreen is great because it goes on light and hydrates. It also does not cause a stinging sensation if you put it around your eyes. I hate sunscreens that do that! It's comforting to have spf 50 in my early morning routine because I have had skin cancer scares in the past. Love this product

I love this sunscreen! Although it has a thinner texture than some sunscreen it absorbs easily and is very lightweight. I have very sensitive skin that often gets irritated and itchy from sunscreen but the Kiehl's didnt cause any issues. It also didn't clog my pores and offered fantastic protection. I'm a fan and will continue to use this product after being sent a sample to try out.

extraits.titre: I will definitely buy this product for future use!
extraits.texte: What I love about this sunscreen is that it's light weight and very easy to blend in with your skin. I have oily skin and this sunscreen didn't clog my pores nor cause any excess oil or breakouts on my skin. I wore this sunscreen under my makeup . It provided excellent protection , overall coverage and worked very well with my makeup products.
